segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: I would like to welcome everyone to this budget hearing of the Civil Service Commission,

segments.text: including the Career Executive Service Board, headed by Chairperson Marilyn B. Yap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: As the agency responsible for managing and strengthening the government's human resources,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: the CSC recognizes the need to continuously modernize its systems

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Digital transformation is no longer simply an option.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: It is essential to providing faster, more efficient, and more accessible government services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, the CSC is proposing a total budget of 3.89 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: an increase of 1.14 billion, or 41.4% from the fiscal year 2026

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Among its key initiatives are the rollout of Prime Embedded Systems Governance, ESG,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: the HRMIS payroll system, and the development of a national learning management system.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: These initiatives are intended to make human resource services more efficient,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: while also improving the delivery of services to government employees,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: I will enable the CAC to maintain reliable, secure, and continuous operation

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: while advancing the modernization of the civil service.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: With the continued trust and support of Congress,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: the Civil Service Commission will be better positioned

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: to lead the modernization of human resource governance

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: and contribute to a more efficient, responsive,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.

segments.text: this unemployment arrangement, is still crucial for projects and programs that are temporary or episodic in nature,

segments.text: But I agree, Mr. Congressman, that the challenge for all of us is how to minimize,
